description: Numi - text calculator where sums are written as plain sentences (units, currencies, dates, percentages)
notes: Installs the app payload straight from Numi's own Squirrel update feed instead of numi-setup.exe from the site: the nupkg is the same build, carries a per-version URL and needs no nested unpacking of the installer.
checkver reads the last entry of that feed's RELEASES index, which is what the app itself asks for when it looks for an update.
In-app updates cannot work here - Squirrel's Update.exe lives outside the app folder and is deliberately not installed. Use 'scoop update numi'.
Notes, preferences and logs live in %APPDATA%\Numi - they survive updates and are NOT removed on uninstall.
